section.49: The Description of the Prophet, may Allah Bless Him and Grant Him Peace

49.name_native: The Description of the Prophet, may Allah Bless Him and Grant Him Peace

hadiths.text: Yahya related to me from Malik from Ibn Shihab that A'isha, umm al-muminin and Sad ibn Abi Waqqas did not see any harm in a man drinking while standing
